title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Horseshoe Casino Tunica, Robinsonville | 2000
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Bluesville Showcase Nightclub at the Horseshoe Casino Tunica in Robinsonville (later Tunica Resorts), Mississippi, USA, on 1 June 2000.

It was the 16th show by the sixth All-Starr Band. Their North American tour lasted for 32 dates between May and July 2000.

Starr had previously performed at the Bluesville Showcase Nightclub on 25 March 1999. He returned there on 16 August 2001, 21 August 2003, and 3 July 2014.

The sixth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Dave Edmunds: vocals, guitar
  • Jack Bruce: vocals, bass guitar, keyboards
  • Eric Carmen: vocals, keyboards, guitar, bass guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, guitar, organ, keyboards, percussion, harmonica
  • Simon Kirke: vocals, drums
